active_rules.directive: Limit opening hooks to <=12 words. Lead with an active engineering verb or high-contrast claim in the first 3 words.
active_rules.rationale: Viewer retention drop-off spikes beyond 15 words; 0-1.5s scroll-stopping velocity requires immediate contrast.

active_rules.directive: Always pair quantitative benchmark numbers (SWE-bench, latency, VRAM) with a concrete architecture mechanism (KV-cache, MoE, LoRA).
active_rules.rationale: Posts with generic claims without mechanisms suffer from shallow engagement and low peer-to-peer sharing.

active_rules.directive: End every broadcast with an architectural tradeoff debate question (e.g., 'Dense vs MoE' or 'VRAM footprint vs Throughput').
active_rules.rationale: High-value engineering comments trigger algorithmic distribution bursts across Threads and Instagram.

active_rules.directive: Never invent numbers or unverified benchmark deltas. Format boilerplate (e.g. 30s breakdown) must be kept strictly separated from factual lab metrics.
active_rules.rationale: Preserves brand credibility and prevents automated Quality Gate blocks.
